diagnosis: MDM2 gene amplification in a dedifferentiated liposarcoma of the thigh
legend: Silver in situ hybridization of the MDM2 gene on the cell block of an FNAB of a deeply located soft tissue mass of the thigh. Amplification of the MDM2 gene with clusters of MDM2 gene signals (black) and 1–2 red centromeric CEP12 signals.

EWSR1 gene FISH demonstrating the rearrangement of this gene, which can be seen in numerous soft tissue tumours, including Ewing sarcoma, liposarcoma, and clear cell sarcoma (among others). The break-apart FISH probe demonstrates one fused signal (white arrows) and one split signal (red and green arrows) in the nuclei (blue) of the tumour, indicating the rearrangement of the EWSR1 gene.

diagnosis: MDM2 gene amplification on FISH performed on a direct FNAB smear
legend: MDM2 gene FISH of an FNAB direct smear of a lipomatous mass from the retroperitoneum, demonstrating MDM2 gene amplification (multiple clustered green MDM2 gene signals indicated by green arrows, in contrast to isolated 1–2 red centromeric signals per nucleus, indicated by red arrows), rendering the diagnosis of a well-differentiated liposarcoma.

diagnosis: SS18 gene rearrangement in a primary pleuropulmonary synovial sarcoma
legend: SS18 gene rearrangement in an FNAB of a pleuropulmonary mass, showing one fused signal (white arrows) and one split signal (red and green arrows) of a break-apart FISH probe.

diagnosis: COL1A1 gene FISH in a dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
legend: COL1A1 gene FISH of an FNAB of a direct smear of a superficial mass of the back. The nuclei show one fused signal and one split signal with concomitant amplification of the red signals (red arrows), diagnostic for dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans.
